code:
POLARITY - a sisterly life sim.

then the title.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; BOOT - runs once after SYSTEM INIT.
; Bank BASIC out ($01=$36): the charsets/maps/texts above $A000 are RAM.
; Quiet the CIA timer interrupts: only our raster interrupts run.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$36
STA $01
LDA #$7F
STA $DC0D
STA $DD0D
LDA $DC0D
LDA $DD0D
LDA #$01
STA $C01E
LDA #$00
STA $C027
STA $D015
LDA #$A7
STA $C01C
JMP Title

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
Title picture + theme tune.
Alternates with HOW TO PLAY.
FIRE starts a new life.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; TITLE: the picture, the tune and the SFX player are set up above.
; Start the raster interrupt chain (IrqMusic at line 251 plays the tune
; and SFX every frame), then hold the title screen.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
SEI
LDA #<IrqMusic
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqMusic
STA $0315
LDA #$FB
STA $D012
LDA $D011
AND #$7F
STA $D011
LDA #$01
STA $D01A
STA $D019
CLI
JMP TitleHold

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; TITLE CYCLE: the picture for 5 seconds, then HOW TO PLAY for 12
; seconds, then back to the picture. FIRE on either starts a new life.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
TitleHold:
LDA #$00
STA $D015
STA $C027
THRelease:
JSR FrameTick
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ THRelease
LDA #$FA               ; 250 frames = 5 seconds
STA $C01F
LDA #$00
STA $C020
THPic:
JSR FrameTick
JSR TitleFire
JSR TitleCount
BNE THPic
JSR ShowHelp
LDA #$58               ; 600 frames = 12 seconds
STA $C01F
LDA #$02
STA $C020
THHelp:
JSR FrameTick
JSR TitleFire
JSR TitleCount
BNE THHelp
JMP TitlePic

; TitleCount: 16-bit countdown in T0/T1, Z set when it reaches zero.
TitleCount:
LDA $C01F
BNE TCLow
DEC $C020
TCLow:
DEC $C01F
LDA $C01F
ORA $C020
RTS

; TitleFire: FIRE pressed? wait for release, then start the game.
TitleFire:
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ TFGo
RTS
TFGo:
JSR FrameTick
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ TFGo
LDX #$FF
TXS
LDA $D012
EOR $C01C
ORA #$01
STA $C01C
JMP StartGame

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; HOW TO PLAY page: copy the home charset (it holds the font) into
; VIC memory, then the VIC / CLEAR / PRINT nodes below draw the page.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$00
STA $D015
STA $C027
JSR CopyRoomGfx

code: *  P O L A R I T Y  *

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
FrameTick: frame wait.
IrqMusic: raster IRQ chain
(tune, SFX, sky/HUD split).

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; IrqMusic (raster line 251): ack, play the tune (when on), set up the
; next interrupt of the chain, then the SFX UPDATE node below runs and
; JMP $EA81 returns.  Chain: 251 music -> 58 sky colour -> 218 black.
; The sky / black split gives the HUD rows a black background while the
; scene in between shows the sky colour of the current hour.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
LDA $C01E
BEQ IrqNoTune
JSR sng501000_play
IrqNoTune:
LDA #<IrqSky
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqSky
STA $0315
LDA #58
STA $D012

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
JMP $EA81              ; KERNAL: pull Y, X, A and RTI

; IrqSky (line 58): the scene rows show the sky colour.
IrqSky:
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
LDA $C027
BEQ ISkyNext
LDA $C026
STA $D021
ISkyNext:
LDA #<IrqHud
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqHud
STA $0315
LDA #218
STA $D012
JMP $EA81

; IrqHud (line 218): black behind the bottom HUD and the top status row.
IrqHud:
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
LDA $C027
BEQ IHudNext
LDA #$00
STA $D021
IHudNext:
LDA #<IrqMusic
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqMusic
STA $0315
LDA #$FB
STA $D012
JMP $EA81

; Reset the sisters' needs, money, clock and job, then walk into HOME.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$00
STA $C000
STA $C002
STA $C003
STA $C00C
STA $C00D
STA $C014
STA $C015
STA $C018
STA $C023
STA $C024
STA $C029
STA $C028
STA $C007
STA $C006
STA $C005
LDA #20
STA $C008
LDA #$01
STA $C00A
STA $C013
STA $C009
LDA #8
STA $C00B
LDA #36
LDX #4
NGNeeds:
STA $C00E,X
DEX
BPL NGNeeds
LDA #60
STA $C001

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
Each place: own CHAR_SET +
MAP (40x20) + colour table.
HOME STREET SHOP CAFE PARK

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
// @asset CHARS_HOME
// @asset CHARS_STREET
// @asset CHARS_SHOP
// @asset CHARS_CAFE
// @asset CHARS_PARK
// @asset MAP_HOME
// @asset MAP_STREET
// @asset MAP_SHOP
// @asset MAP_CAFE
// @asset MAP_PARK
; (these lines tell the build to include every place's charset and map:
;  this block copies them in itself, no node marks them as used)
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; ENTER ROOM: blank the screen, copy this place's charset + colours,
; draw its 40x20 map into rows 1-20, name it, spawn a coin / bee.
; Reset the stack: room changes jump here from inside joystick handlers.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
EnterRoom:
LDX #$FF
TXS
LDA #$FE
STA $C01D              ; next frame shows this spot's prompt / hint
EnterRoomKeep:
LDA $D011
AND #$EF
STA $D011
JSR CopyRoomGfx
JSR DrawRoom
JSR PlaceName
JSR SpawnThings
JSR SetSky
JSR FrameTick
LDA $D011
ORA #$10
STA $D011
JMP MainLoop

; CopyRoomGfx: this room's CHAR_SET -> $3000 (2K), its colour table -> $C100.
CopyRoomGfx:
LDX $C000
LDA $BD32,X
STA $55
LDA #$00
STA $54
STA $50
LDA #$30
STA $51
LDX #$08
LDY #$00
CRGLoop:
LDA ($54),Y
STA ($50),Y
INY
BNE CRGLoop
INC $55
INC $51
DEX
BNE CRGLoop
LDA $C000
CLC
ADC #$B8
STA $55
LDY #$00
CRGCol:
LDA ($54),Y
STA $C100,Y
INY
BNE CRGCol
RTS

; DrawRoom: map (40x20 chars) -> screen rows 1-20, colour from the table.
DrawRoom:
LDX $C000
LDA $BD28,X
STA $54
LDA $BD2D,X
STA $55
LDA #$28
STA $50
STA $52
LDA #$04
STA $51
LDA #$D8
STA $53
LDA #20
STA $C01F
DRRow:
LDY #$00
DRCol:
LDA ($54),Y
STA ($50),Y
TAX
LDA $C100,X
STA ($52),Y
INY
CPY #40
BNE DRCol
LDA $54
CLC
ADC #40
STA $54
BCC DRSrc
INC $55
DRSrc:
LDA $50
CLC
ADC #40
STA $50
STA $52
BCC DRDst
INC $51
INC $53
DRDst:
DEC $C01F
BNE DRRow
RTS

; PlaceName: 6-char place name into the top status row.
PlaceName:
LDA $C000
ASL
STA $C01F
ASL
CLC
ADC $C01F
TAX
LDY #$00
PNLoop:
LDA $BD51,X
STA $0410,Y
LDA #$03
STA $D810,Y
INX
INY
CPY #6
BNE PNLoop
RTS

; SpawnThings: maybe a floating coin (street, shop, park) and a bee
; (street, park, daytime). Coins have a 2 hour cooldown after a catch.
SpawnThings:
LDA #$00
STA $C015
STA $C018
LDX $C000
LDA $BD1E,X
STA $C020
AND #$01
BEQ STBee
LDA $C028
BNE STBee
JSR Rand
AND #$01
BEQ STBee
LDA #$01
STA $C015
JSR Rand
AND #$3F
CLC
ADC #40
STA $C016
LDA #$6C
STA $C017
STBee:
LDA $C020
AND #$02
BEQ STDone
LDA $C00B
CMP #7
BCC STDone
CMP #20
BCS STDone
JSR Rand
AND #$03
BEQ STDone
LDA #$01
STA $C018
LDA #$92
STA $C01A
LDA #29
STA $C024            ; a moment's grace before it can sting
LDA $C001
CMP #74
BCS STBeeLeft
LDA #140
STA $C019
RTS
STBeeLeft:
LDA #6
STA $C019
STDone:
RTS

; Rand: 8-bit Galois LFSR -> A
Rand:
LDA $C01C
ASL
BCC RandNo
EOR #$1D
RandNo:
STA $C01C
RTS

; SetSky: sky colour for the current hour (the raster split shows it).
SetSky:
LDX $C00B
LDA $BD00,X
STA $C026
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; JOYSTICK HANDLERS (JSR'd by the JOYSTICK node; each must RTS).
; JOYID / PREVJOY give edge detection for UP and DOWN.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
JoyFire:
LDA #$01
STA $C005
LDA $C00F
CMP #2
BCS JFCast
LDA $C006
CMP #$01
BEQ JFDone
LDA #$37
JMP PrintMsg
JFCast:
LDA #$01
STA $C01B
LDA $C006
CMP #$01
BEQ JFDrain
JSR SndMagic
JFDrain:
INC $C022            ; magic costs 1 REST every 64 frames
LDA $C022
AND #$3F
BNE JFDone
DEC $C00F
JMP RefreshBars
JFDone:
RTS

JoyUp:
LDA #$02
STA $C005
LDA $C006
CMP #$02
BEQ JUDone
JMP DoAction
JUDone:
RTS

JoyDown:
LDA #$03
STA $C005
LDA $C006
CMP #$03
BEQ JDDone
LDA $C003             ; SWAP SISTERS
EOR #$01
STA $C003
LDA #30
STA $C023
JSR SndSwap
JSR RefreshNames
LDA $C003
CLC
ADC #$3E
JMP PrintMsg
JDDone:
RTS

JoyLeft:
LDA #$04
STA $C005
LDA #$01
STA $C002
STA $C004
LDA $C001
CMP #$02
BCC JLEdge
DEC $C001
RTS
JLEdge:
LDA $C000
BEQ JLWall
DEC $C000
LDA #145
STA $C001
JMP EnterRoom
JLWall:
RTS

JoyRight:
LDA #$05
STA $C005
LDA #$00
STA $C002
LDA #$01
STA $C004
LDA $C001
CMP #146
BCS JREdge
INC $C001
LDA $C000             ; just reached the park fence?
CMP #$04
BNE JRDone
LDA $C001
CMP #146
BNE JRDone
LDA #$4B
JMP PrintMsg
JREdge:
LDA $C000
CMP #$04
BEQ JRFence
INC $C000
LDA #$02
STA $C001
JMP EnterRoom
JRFence:
LDA $C006
CMP #$05
BEQ JRDone
LDA #$4B
JMP PrintMsg
JRDone:
RTS

JoyNone:
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; DrawGirl: sprite 0 = hair (hires), sprite 1 = body (multicolour).
; X = PX*2+24 (9 bits). Body frame: walk A/B, cast pose, facing L/R.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
DrawGirl:
LDA $C001
JSR SprX
STA $D000
STA $D002
LDA $D010
AND #$FC
LDX $C02C
BEQ DGHi
ORA #$03
DGHi:
STA $D010
LDA #$A6
STA $D001
STA $D003
LDA $C002
ASL
STA $C01F               ; 0 right, 2 left
LDA $C01B
BEQ DGWalk
LDA $C002
CLC
ADC #$E4
JMP DGBody
DGWalk:
LDA $C004
BEQ DGStand
LDA $C025
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC $C01F
JMP DGBodyA
DGStand:
LDA $C01F
DGBodyA:
CLC
ADC #$E0
DGBody:
STA $07F9
LDA $C003
ASL
CLC
ADC $C002
CLC
ADC #$E6
STA $07F8
LDX $C003
LDA $BD1A,X
STA $D027
LDA $BD18,X
STA $D028
RTS

; SprX: A = position (0-159 half pixels) -> A = low byte of A*2+24,
; SPRHI = bit 8.
SprX:
ASL
STA $C020
LDA #$00
ROL
STA $C02C
LDA $C020
CLC
ADC #24
BCC SXDone
INC $C02C
SXDone:
RTS

; SetHi: A = sprite bit mask, SPRHI -> set or clear that bit of $D010.
SetHi:
LDX $C02C
BEQ SHClear
ORA $D010
STA $D010
RTS
SHClear:
EOR #$FF
AND $D010
STA $D010
RTS

; SprOn / SprOff: A = sprite bit mask
SprOn:
ORA $D015
STA $D015
RTS
SprOff:
EOR #$FF
AND $D015
STA $D015
RTS

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; DrawMagic (sprite 2): the swap sparkle, the sleep Zzz, or the magic
; itself in front of her while FIRE is held - hearts for Sunny's
; ATTRACTION, zaps for Hex's REPULSION.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
DrawMagic:
LDA $C023
BEQ DMNoSwap
DEC $C023
LDA $C025
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #$F2
STA $07FA
LDA #$01
STA $D029
LDA $C001
JMP DMShow
DMNoSwap:
LDA $C01B
BNE DMCast
LDA #$04
JMP SprOff
DMCast:
LDA $C025
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
STA $C01F
LDA $C003
ASL
CLC
ADC $C01F
CLC
ADC #$EE
STA $07FA
LDX $C003
LDA $BF5D,X
STA $D029
LDA $C002
BNE DMLeft
LDA $C001
CLC
ADC #10
JMP DMShow
DMLeft:
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC #10
BCS DMShow
LDA #$00
DMShow:
JSR SprX
STA $D004
LDA #$04
JSR SetHi
LDA #$A6
STA $D005
LDA #$04
JMP SprOn

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; UpdateCoin (sprite 3): it floats out of reach. Sunny's ATTRACTION pulls
; it down to her (+$5); Hex's REPULSION pushes it away for good.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
UpdateCoin:
LDA $C015
BNE UCOn
LDA #$08
JMP SprOff
UCOn:
LDA $C01B
BEQ UCFloat
LDA $C003
BNE UCRepel
LDA $C016            ; ATTRACT: towards her...
CMP $C001
BEQ UCDown
BCS UCLeft
INC $C016
JMP UCDown
UCLeft:
DEC $C016
UCDown:
LDA $C017            ; ...and down to her hands
CMP #160
BCS UCCatch
INC $C017
INC $C017
JMP UCCatch
UCRepel:
LDA $C016
CMP $C001
BCC UCPushL
INC $C016
INC $C016
LDA $C016
CMP #150
BCS UCGone
JMP UCDraw
UCPushL:
DEC $C016
DEC $C016
LDA $C016
CMP #4
BCC UCGone
JMP UCDraw
UCGone:
LDA #$00
STA $C015
LDA #$39
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$08
JMP SprOff
UCFloat:
LDA $C017            ; drift back up, bob gently
CMP #$6C
BCC UCDraw
BEQ UCDraw
LDA $C025
AND #$03
BNE UCDraw
DEC $C017
JMP UCDraw
UCCatch:
LDA $C017
CMP #150
BCC UCDraw
LDA $C016
SEC
SBC $C001
BCS UCAbs
EOR #$FF
ADC #$01
UCAbs:
CMP #6
BCS UCDraw
LDA #$00               ; caught it!
STA $C015
LDA #$02
STA $C028
LDA #5
JSR AddMoney
JSR RefreshMoney
JSR SndCoin
LDA #$38
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$08
JMP SprOff
UCDraw:
LDA $C025
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #$EA
STA $07FB
LDA #$07
STA $D02A
LDA $C016
JSR SprX
STA $D006
LDA #$08
JSR SetHi
LDA $C025
AND #$10
LSR
LSR
LSR
LSR
CLC
ADC $C017
STA $D007
LDA #$08
JMP SprOn

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; UpdateBee (sprite 4): drifts after her and stings (FUN-8). Hex's
; REPULSION blasts it away for good; Sunny's ATTRACTION reels it in!
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
UpdateBee:
LDA $C018
BNE UBOn
LDA #$10
JMP SprOff
UBOn:
LDA $C024
BEQ UBNoCool
DEC $C024
UBNoCool:
LDA $C01B
BEQ UBDrift
LDA $C003
BEQ UBLove
LDA $C019             ; REPEL: three steps away per frame
CMP $C001
BCC UBRepL
CLC
ADC #3
STA $C019
CMP #150
BCS UBGone
JMP UBDraw
UBRepL:
SEC
SBC #3
STA $C019
BCC UBGone
CMP #4
BCC UBGone
JMP UBDraw
UBGone:
LDA #$00
STA $C018
LDA #6
LDX #3
JSR AddNeed
JSR RefreshBars
JSR SndUse
LDA #$3A
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$10
JMP SprOff
UBLove:
LDA $C006          ; ATTRACT: it comes for her, fast
CMP #$01
BEQ UBLove2
LDA #$3B
JSR PrintMsg
UBLove2:
JSR BeeToward
JSR BeeToward
JMP UBSting
UBDrift:
LDA $C024            ; just stung: back off a little
BEQ UBChase
CMP #30
BCC UBChase
LDA $C019
CMP $C001
BCC UBBackL
CMP #146
BCS UBBackDone
INC $C019
JMP UBDraw
UBBackL:
CMP #4
BCC UBBackDone
DEC $C019
UBBackDone:
JMP UBDraw
UBChase:
LDA $C025
AND #$01
BNE UBSting
JSR BeeToward
UBSting:
LDA $C024
BNE UBDraw
LDA $C019
SEC
SBC $C001
BCS UBAbs
EOR #$FF
ADC #$01
UBAbs:
CMP #5
BCS UBDraw
LDA #100               ; STING!
STA $C024
LDA #$F8
LDX #3
JSR AddNeedSoft
JSR RefreshBars
JSR SndOuch
LDA $C003
CLC
ADC #$3C
JSR PrintMsg
UBDraw:
LDA $C025
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #$EC
STA $07FC
LDA #$07
STA $D02B
LDA $C019
JSR SprX
STA $D008
LDA #$10
JSR SetHi
LDA $C025
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$03
CLC
ADC $C01A
STA $D009
LDA #$10
JMP SprOn

CMP $C001
BEQ BTDone

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
2 s = 10 minutes. Needs drop
hourly. UP uses an object:
ACTION table drives it.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; ClockTick: every 100 frames (2 s) = 10 game minutes.
; Each hour the needs drop a little ($BD23) and the sky changes.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
ClockTick:
INC $C00D
LDA $C00D
CMP #$64
BCC CTDone
LDA #$00
STA $C00D
LDA #$01               ; a real-time hour can empty a need (faint);
STA $C02A             ; hours spent inside an action stop at 1
JSR AddTime
LDA #$00
STA $C02A
JMP RefreshClock
CTDone:
RTS

; AddTime: A = how many 10-minute steps pass.
AddTime:
STA $C02D
ATLoop:
LDA $C02D
BEQ ATDone
DEC $C02D
INC $C00C
LDA $C00C
CMP #6
BCC ATLoop
LDA #$00
STA $C00C
JSR NextHour
JMP ATLoop
ATDone:
RTS

NextHour:
INC $C00B
LDA $C00B
CMP #24
BCC NHDecay
LDA #$00
STA $C00B
INC $C00A
NHDecay:
LDA $C028
BEQ NHCool
DEC $C028
NHCool:
LDX #4
NHNeed:
LDA $BD23,X
EOR #$FF
CLC
ADC #$01
STX $C02E
LDY $C02A
BEQ NHSoft
JSR AddNeed
JMP NHNext
NHSoft:
JSR AddNeedSoft
NHNext:
LDX $C02E
DEX
BPL NHNeed
JSR RefreshBars
JSR SetSky
LDA $C00B             ; cafe closing time while she is there
CMP #18
BNE NHWarn
LDA $C000
CMP #3
BNE NHWarn
LDA #$4C
JMP PrintMsg
NHWarn:
LDX #$00               ; first need running low -> warning
NHWLoop:
LDA $C00E,X
CMP #8
BCC NHWShow
INX
CPX #5
BNE NHWLoop
RTS
NHWShow:
LDA $BF53,X
JSR PrintMsg
JMP SndError

; AddNeed: X = need (0-4), A = signed change. Result clamped 0-48.
AddNeed:
CLC
ADC $C00E,X
BMI ANZero
CMP #49
BCC ANStore
LDA #48
JMP ANStore
ANZero:
LDA #$00
ANStore:
STA $C00E,X
RTS

; AddNeedSoft: as AddNeed, but never below 1. Actions, stings, sleep and
; magic can run a need low; only the hourly drop can empty it (faint).
AddNeedSoft:
JSR AddNeed
LDA $C00E,X
BNE ANSDone
LDA #$01
STA $C00E,X
ANSDone:
RTS

code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; CheckSpot: which object (if any) is she standing at? When it changes,
; show its prompt (or the room hint) on the message line.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
CheckSpot:
LDA $C001
CLC
ADC #6
LSR
LSR
STA $C01F               ; her centre column
LDX $C000
LDA $BDB1,X
TAX
LDY #4
CSLoop:
LDA $BD75,X
CMP #$FF
BEQ CSNone
LDA $C01F
CMP $BD75,X
BCC CSNext
LDA $BD76,X
CMP $C01F
BCC CSNext
LDA $BD77,X
JMP CSFound
CSNext:
INX
INX
INX
DEY
BNE CSLoop
CSNone:
LDA #$FF
CSFound:
CMP $C01D
BEQ CSSame
STA $C01D
CMP #$FF
BEQ CSHint

LDA $BE5E,X
TAX
LDA $BDC0,X
JMP PrintMsg
CSHint:

LDA $BF58,X

CSSame:
RTS

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; DoAction (UP): use the object she stands at. The action table gives
; need changes, the price, the time it takes and the messages; special
; actions (sleep, eat, groceries, work, chat) add their own rules.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
DoAction:
LDA $C01D
CMP #$FF
BNE DAHave
LDA #$01
JMP PrintMsg
DAHave:
CMP #$00
BNE DANotSleep
JMP DoSleep
DANotSleep:
TAX
LDA $BE5E,X
STA $C021               ; T2 = offset of this action's row
TAX
LDA $BDBF,X
CMP #$02
BNE DANotEat
LDA $C009
BNE DAEatOk
LDA #$33
JMP DAFail
DAEatOk:
DEC $C009
JMP DAPay
DANotEat:
CMP #$04
BNE DAPay
LDA $C00B
CMP #8
BCC DAClosed
CMP #18
BCS DAClosed
LDA $C00F
CMP #10
BCS DAPay
LDA #$35
JMP DAFail
DAClosed:
LDA #$34
JMP DAFail
DAPay:
LDX $C021
LDA $BDBB,X
BEQ DANeeds
JSR HaveMoney
BCS DAPayOk
LDA #$32
JMP DAFail
DAPayOk:
LDX $C021
LDA $BDBB,X
JSR SubMoney
DANeeds:
LDA #$00
STA $C02E
DANLoop:
LDA $C021
CLC
ADC $C02E
TAX
LDA $BDB6,X
LDX $C02E
JSR AddNeedSoft
INC $C02E
LDA $C02E
CMP #5
BNE DANLoop
LDX $C021
LDA $BDBF,X
CMP #$03
BNE DANotGroc
LDA $C009
CLC
ADC #3
CMP #10
BCC DAGrocOk
LDA #9
DAGrocOk:
STA $C009
JMP DATime
DANotGroc:
CMP #$05
BNE DANotChat
LDA $C003             ; Sunny's attraction: everyone loves her
BNE DATime
LDA #8
LDX #4
JSR AddNeedSoft
JMP DATime
DANotChat:
CMP #$04
BNE DATime
JSR DoWork
DATime:
LDX $C021
LDA $BDBC,X
JSR AddTime
JSR SndUse
LDX $C021
LDA $C003
BNE DAHexMsg
LDA $BDBD,X
JMP DAMsg
DAHexMsg:
LDA $BDBE,X
DAMsg:
JSR PrintMsg
JSR RefreshHud
LDA $C013            ; the fifth job level is the dream come true
CMP #5
BCC DADone
JMP WinGame
DADone:
RTS
DAFail:
JSR PrintMsg
JMP SndError

; DoWork: pay the wage (+tips for Sunny), job XP (Hex works double hard),
; promotion every 6 XP. No XP when scruffy (WASH low).
DoWork:
LDX $C013
LDA $BD6F,X
LDX $C003
BNE DWPay
CLC
ADC #4                 ; Sunny's tips
DWPay:
JSR AddMoney
LDA $C010
CMP #12
BCS DWXp
PLA                    ; skip the normal result message
PLA
LDX $C021
LDA $BDBC,X
JSR AddTime
JSR RefreshHud
LDA #$36
JSR PrintMsg
JMP SndError
DWXp:
INC $C014
LDA $C003
BEQ DWCheck
INC $C014
DWCheck:
LDA $C014
CMP #6
BCC DWDone
LDA #$00
STA $C014
INC $C013
PLA                    ; promotion replaces the normal message
PLA
LDX $C021
LDA $BDBC,X
JSR AddTime
JSR RefreshHud
JSR SndPromote
LDX $C013
LDA $BF5F,X
JSR PrintMsg
LDA $C013
CMP #5
BCC DWDone
LDA #150
JSR Pause
JMP WinGame
DWDone:
RTS

; DoSleep: in bed at night (20:00-5:59) or when very tired: sleep till
; 7:00 next morning, REST full. Otherwise just a nap.
DoSleep:
LDA $C00B
CMP #20
BCS DSSleep
CMP #6
BCC DSSleep
LDA $C00F
CMP #16
BCC DSSleep
LDA #12
LDX #1
JSR AddNeedSoft
LDA #6
JSR AddTime
JSR SndUse
LDA #$31
JSR PrintMsg
JMP RefreshHud
DSSleep:
JSR SndSleep
LDA #$00
STA $C015
STA $C018
LDA #$00
STA $D015              ; hide the girl: she is under the covers
LDA #$F4
STA $07FA
LDA #$00
STA $D029
LDA #20
JSR SprX
STA $D004
LDA #$04
JSR SetHi
LDA #132
STA $D005
LDA #$04
JSR SprOn
LDA #$06
STA $C026
LDA #180
JSR Pause
LDA $C00B
CMP #7
BCC DSSameDay
INC $C00A
DSSameDay:
LDA #7
STA $C00B
LDA #$00
STA $C00C
STA $C00D
LDA #48
STA $C00F
LDA #$F6
LDX #0
JSR AddNeedSoft
LDA #$F8
LDX #2
JSR AddNeedSoft
LDA #$03
STA $D015
JSR SetSky
JSR RefreshHud
LDX $C003
LDA #$15
CPX #$00
BEQ DSMsg
LDA #$16

JMP PrintMsg

; Pause: A = frames to wait (music keeps playing).
Pause:
STA $C02D
PLoop:
JSR FrameTick
DEC $C02D
BNE PLoop
RTS

; CheckFaint: a need at zero -> she faints, wakes at home 4 hours later.
CheckFaint:
LDX #4
CFLoop:
LDA $C00E,X
BEQ CFFaint
DEX
BPL CFLoop
RTS
CFFaint:
JSR SndOuch
LDA #$49
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$00
STA $D015
LDA #120
JSR Pause
LDA #24                ; 4 hours pass while she recovers...
JSR AddTime
LDX #4                 ; ...then she wakes with every need at 16+
CFFix:
LDA $C00E,X
CMP #16
BCS CFOk
LDA #16
STA $C00E,X
CFOk:
DEX
BPL CFFix
LDA #10
JSR HaveMoney
BCC CFBroke
LDA #10
JSR SubMoney
JMP CFHome
CFBroke:
LDA #$00
STA $C008
CFHome:
LDA #$49
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$03
STA $D015
LDA #$00
STA $C000
LDA #52
STA $C001
JSR RefreshHud
LDA #$FF
STA $C01D              ; keep the faint message up
LDX #$FF
TXS
JMP EnterRoomKeep
